evidence.excerpt: The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 lunch PDF enumerates the complete lunch food surface with item descriptions and dietary icons. It says CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment and asks guests to notify servers of food allergies or dietary restrictions.

The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 dinner PDF enumerates the complete dinner food surface with item descriptions and dietary icons. It repeats the not-a-gluten-free-environment and server-notification statements.

The restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront identifies Circa at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd and exposes the current takeout catalog. Its Soup of the Day descriptions name crab, chicken, and shrimp variants; it adds Broccolini and Crispy Brussels + Blue to the current union but exposes no comprehensive allergen matrix.
The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 brunch PDF enumerates the complete brunch food, side, salad, sandwich, and flatbread surface with literal ingredient descriptions.

The current restaurant-controlled location page identifies CIRCA at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd, Arlington, VA 22201 and exposes the location-specific lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, happy-hour, zero-proof, and nonalcoholic-beer menus.
The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 beverage PDF lists the current zero-proof cocktails and nonalcoholic beers; alcoholic products were excluded from the POC product boundary.
The restaurant-controlled online-ordering hub separately links the Clarendon location to the ChowNow location 34557 storefront.
